desc:
>> this is NOT related to Crash Town Game Thing. 

>> VERY IMPORTANT: the game will inevitably be laggy. i can't fix that. if you want  super smoooth physics, then this might not be what you're looking for. 
most of the physics is server-sided (which is intended). 
a temporary solution is to not spawn too many vehicles or join a server with less players (or a private server).

>> controls work for both PC and Mobile. 

>> If your vehicle won't move even with the engine on, 
- jump out and enter it again 
- or respawn it 
(controls are usually regained 2.5 seconds after crashing.) 

>> models are NOT being released. 

>> join a private server for ability to spawn multiple vehicles.
